environment.description: Container deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Security group allows inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or request filtering. The ALB has access logging enabled to S3 but no active rule evaluation. Container runs with task role arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/ecs-app-task-role which has no relevance to the SQL injection vector.
